steps.text: November 19th, 1097, 7:44 A.M.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: And you don't remember when someone first opened it up?

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Has to have been two months ago, at least.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: But we always sealed this part off with planks. A few naughty kids pulled them off to climb in a while back, so it might just be the same story this time.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Have you seen anyone go in or out?

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: No, it's dark as night down here. Why would anyone?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Alright... got it.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: *Sigh* This still isn't making sense... and it's so suspicious. I've already found six abandoned structures up till now where the entryway's started being used again.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Plenty of witnesses are testifying about dragging sounds from the underground channels at evening, too. The atmosphere around the Infected community just doesn't sit right. It feels like someone's fiddling about.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Not one person's got a reason to be using these entrances again...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: (Claps face)

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Forget it, enough of that for now. Both the littlest things and the big stuff the town's survival hinges on are just as important, yep!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Let's see what else there is... Oh, yeah... the burglary case at Count Bishmer's.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Where do I start investigating that?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: *Sigh*... Who would it be? Slipping past a noble house's strict defenses and stealing something isn't your standard thief's fare.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: According to the Count's servants, the burglar pops in and out all over the Infected neighborhood. So, they're either extra familiar with the terrain there, or have special Originium Arts.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: —Of course, that's assuming the servants aren't lying to avoid responsibility.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: ...Hmm, I don't think they would though. I've heard a lot of similar reports the last two weeks. All signs say there really is some thief on the run in Caladon City.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: A very strange thief, special Originium Arts...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Whatever, let's drop by the Infected community and see.

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: Grani, finally found you!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Mrs. Sunny? Calm down, calm down, what's the matter?

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: My little Pom's run away! I've been looking for two hours already, help me find him! He usually listens so well, he's never run off before, what if someone bad finds him...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: No worries, Missus, I'll help you look right away!

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: Thank you, thank you!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Did anything happen right before Pom ran away? Have you asked anyone nearby? ...Ah, don't rush, Missus, take it slow...
An hour later.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Over here, Mrs. Sunny, I've found Pom!

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: Oh...! Let me take a look. Phew, that's a relief... he's still alright. I'm so sorry to trouble you, Grani, I know you're so busy with work, and here I am making you search for a pet of all things.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Don't worry about it. If Pom really did vanish, you'd be torn to pieces! I wouldn't call that nothing!

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: But, I heard John next door saying you aren't getting along too well with the Guards, and they even got on your case a few days ago for something or other...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Hahaha... it was nothing.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: But if you're going to raise a fowlbeast, Mrs. Sunny, I'd recommend keeping him in a cage... Things would get hairy if he bit anyone.

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: Oh, you've got a point.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Speaking of, Missus, have you seen any strangers about the Infected community lately?

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: Strangers? Plenty of the people here come from other cities—strangers aren't the strangest thing.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I mean the sort that... um... might have uncanny Originium Arts, that sort of Infected?

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: You know how the power went out in the neighborhood last month.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Oh! Yep, the case of some bad actor wrecking the community's generators, right? But we've never found the culprit...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I did hear the supply got restored in no time, though. Did someone fix all the generators up?

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: Right! I heard they got this incredible engineering Caster in, and in a few hours, they already had the generators repaired! Question is, when did the community ever have an engineer so great?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Right... something's definitely odd about that...
November 20th, 1097, 6:44 P.M.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Here's my work report for today. If you could give it a look over, guv'nor.

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Hm. Two robberies, an inquiry report on rumors in Caladon... You must be pulling my leg.

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: What about the burglary at Count Bishmer's?! How long do you think it's been? Get on it!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Um—isn't that one only a day old...?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Is a day not enough?!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: I broke my back getting you as a temporary transfer. The Mounted Police were singing your praises as an investigator. And for what? A day's worth of time isn't enough for you? For one tiny case of property theft?!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: (Under her breath) It was the City Council who borrowed me from the Mounted Police...

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Enough! You don't know respect, you talk back to your senior! Is this how the Mounted Police behave?!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I'm sorry, guv'nor!

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: 'Investigated entranceways of abandoned structures. Turned out to be as suspicious as thought, inquired with surrounding residents...' What the hell is this?! Weren't you told you could leave this be?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Caladon City gets strange business day in, day out, and wherever else the bloody day feels like! If every one of the Guards was as suspicious as you, we'd all be dead from the stress!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: But, guv'nor, if we let this all lie, then there's a real chance...

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Stop with the rubbish, get out and investigate!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Yes, guv'nor!
November 22nd, 1097, 10:20 A.M.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: *Pant*...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Li'l~ Susie~

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Let me give your ears a good rubbie-rub!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Hahaha! What's the matter, Officer Grani?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Something at work, I imagine.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: *Sigh*... Nothing much, just some hiccups lately with my job.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Go on, what exactly's happening?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: It's not that big, to be honest...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: You've all heard the recent rumors in the city, I'm guessing.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Ah, you mean those urban legends in the paper?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Same as ever, I assume. 'Sounds can be heard from the city underground,' 'criminals have infiltrated the Infected community,' and so on.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Right... I was wanting to investigate those. I wrote up a dedicated report over the past few days.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: But the Guards don't care about any of it! They want me to keep my nose out of things!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Eh? Do the Mounted Police investigate urban legends, too?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Come on, that's the wrong idea, Susie!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: My work experience taught me that when these rumors crop up in a city, usually they come from the criminal activity that hides behind it.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Like the 'sounds from underground' one.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Did you know? There's massive runs of logistics channels lying abandoned under Caladon.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Right. In the earlier years, back when the nomadic sectors were being planned, they drafted plenty of channels through the structural layers. But following the city's development, a lot of the old plates' underground ways were too taxing to maintain, so they relinquished them all.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Yep. For example, plenty of them run under the Infected community.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Do you get it now? If those rumors are true, then that means there are people doing something at evening in those empty logistics channels, out of sight.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Er... this is a bit scary, isn't it?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: It's too bad I still don't have any direct proof.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I think you can worry yourself a little less about it. It's meant to be the Guards' job, after all.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: If something does happen later, they're the layabouts. You've got nothing to fear.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Well, if you put it that way...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: *Sigh* It's patrol hours right now, so I guess I'm a layabout myself, sitting here...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Hahaha... we won't tell anyone.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Li'l~ Susie~

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Let me give your ears a good rubbie-rub!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Go ahead, but careful of the static, okay?
November 24th, 1097, 6:15 P.M.
In front of the shambles of the 'Green Spark' stands a thunderstruck Officer Grani.
Before her eyes was that shop full of human warmth—now, with its roof collapsed, walls crumbled, and nothing left but charred black wreckage.
She stares blankly at the ruins in front of her, not daring to believe her eyes.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: ...But why?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Wh... why? Why would...?

steps.name: Fire Brigade Member
steps.text: Oh, Miss Grani, you're here now?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Wh-What happened here? Why is this place...?

steps.name: Fire Brigade Member
steps.text: Too much for me to swallow, too. It could only be out of revenge, setting a place like this alight.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Setting?! Someone set this place on fire?!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: What about the owner here? Where's that Feline girl? Have you seen her?

steps.name: Fire Brigade Member
steps.text: No, we haven't, but no one was in there last night when the fire went up.

steps.name: Fire Brigade Member
steps.text: We're lucky no one's burnt, or worse.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Who the hell did this?!
Anger.
She clenches her fists tight.
The pub she visits practically every week, the adorable owner lady, the diverting guests... A moment of rare respite in this city, now turned to charred rubble.
The anger flooding Grani's mind is hard to keep in check—rarely is she ever this enraged.
She's reached the point of wanting to bring justice to the culprit herself, no matter who it is.

steps.name: Fire Brigade Member
steps.text: Hey! No going in! We still haven't cleaned up the debris yet!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: That's fine, I'm looking over the scene of the crime. I might find something in this.

steps.name: Fire Brigade Member
steps.text: Don't bother, officer.

steps.name: Fire Brigade Member
steps.text: The Guards came over this morning. They looked all around, called it an accident, and left just like that.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: An accident? But didn't you just say...?

steps.name: Fire Brigade Member
steps.text: That's just my opinion as a firefighter. We see a lot of things wherever we're called, and this we've seen.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: What's this... a scrap of explosive?

steps.name: Fire Brigade Member
steps.text: Yeah, but the Guards had us keep out of this, so I didn't say much.

steps.name: Fire Brigade Member
steps.text: And nobody cares, really... about the Infected community. It's all less said, the better.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Can you pass this evidence on to me?

steps.name: Fire Brigade Member
steps.text: Sure, it was burning my hand, anyway. Didn't think I should hold it... and you're with the Guards, at any rate.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Let me see...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Wait, hold on... these are shards from a military-grade incendiary! I've seen this sort back in Mounted Police training.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Is it just me, or... are these shards familiar?
November 26th, 1097, 7:15 A.M.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: So we meet again, Mr. Maud?

steps.name: Loud-Mouthed Man
steps.text: Th... The Mount?!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Did they just let you go? I thought they'd keep you in custody for longer than this.

steps.name: Loud-Mouthed Man
steps.text: Don't take me in again, officer, I'm begging you! All I am's a handyman!

steps.name: Loud-Mouthed Man
steps.text: I haven't bothered about with those Infected in recent, I swear!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Do you still remember that incendiary we confiscated from your loot, a few days ago when I arrested you?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: You said you'd only bought one for 'self-defense'.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: But military-grade bomb shells have a very obvious unique design. They're not hard to identify even when shattered. Can you guess where I found this little piece?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: If you're lying, it's another trip with me back to the Guards.

steps.name: Loud-Mouthed Man
steps.text: No! I'll tell you! Anything you want!

steps.name: Loud-Mouthed Man
steps.text: I bought a case, I confess it! I bought a case! But I sold it all on to other people!

steps.name: Loud-Mouthed Man
steps.text: The Danton brothers! I sold it to the Danton brothers!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: The Danton brothers? Who are they?

steps.name: Loud-Mouthed Man
steps.text: Those two Siracusan immigrants! The two mafia henchmen! Go ask the people at the Boil! They know 'em!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Then do you know why they'd want to burn down an Infected community pub?

steps.name: Loud-Mouthed Man
steps.text: I don't know! I swear, no idea! I didn't hear a thing about the pub!

steps.name: Loud-Mouthed Man
steps.text: I got the firebombs from the—the black market at the Boil, too! I swear, that's the honest truth!

steps.name: Loud-Mouthed Man
steps.text: But the merchant there said, he's got ways of getting goods done directly at the factory...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: (Factories in Caladon... I think there's only Count Bishmer's manufacturing military supplies...)

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Do you know where the Danton brothers are?

steps.name: Loud-Mouthed Man
steps.text: I... I'm not 100%, I just know they always hang around in the Boil...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: The Boil, huh...
November 27th, 1097, 6:15 P.M.

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: How many times have I had to tell you? Have you caught the burglar?! Have you finished your patrols?! Only you Mounted Police sideshow jugglers would obsess over the tiniest meaningless business.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: You call this meaningless business?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Is it not?! Is a single Infected community pub burning down worth you spending three days to investigate?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: A short-circuit in the mains, offended a gang, a lightning strike! I can think of a hundred other reasons still. Once you finally discover there was no culprit at all, who takes responsibility for all the cases this has held up? You?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: So what about this evidence? These military incendiaries were made at Councilor Bishmer's factory, and were meant as supplies for the Victorian Army! But they circulated into the black market!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Doesn't this warrant investigating that factory?!

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: That's Count Bishmer's estate! You're saying you'll sweep a Member of the Council's factory?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: You've got some brass!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Military incendiaries! The underground black market! The evidence is all in front of you! Why are you still playing the idiot here?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Don't tell me, you get a piece of these black market deals too?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: You...! Do you know what you're saying? You dare tell me this to my face?!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Who do you think you're fooling? Count Bishmer's your own relative, isn't he?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: You... you!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: How did someone like you get into the position of Captain of the Guards?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: You don't have a care in you for Infected community cases, and you turn a blind eye when gangs from the Boil cause disaster. And now you're not going to look into something this massive?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Then what IS your job? You've abandoned your duties!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Is there still anyone in the Caladon Guards qualified to enforce the law?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: So you're going to mutiny?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I'm a Mounted Police Officer on temporary transfer here by the City Council! Right now, I'm the one in charge of the Mounted Police of Caladon City—you and I are of the same rank! You should have no authority to order me!

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Fine, then! I just knew you bumpkin lot would...

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: You wait. You just wait until the Duke's back from Londinium. I'll report to him in full detail just the kind of attitude you 'Mounted Police' bring to your work!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Suit yourself! Goodbye!

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Lowly circus spectacles, damned backwater blood... You wait until the Duke's back! You'll get your damn dues!
November 28th, 1097, 7:15 P.M.
White House Pub, The Boil, Caladon

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: What are they doin'? That sets us back a whole day!

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: You think it's some kinda slip-up at the factory?

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Then what do we do now?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: We hold on a little longer... If we still don't get news by this evening, we dip out, pronto.

steps.name: Barman
steps.text: Is there anything I can do for you?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Evening, I'm looking for two people they call 'the Danton Brothers' and I've heard some say they see them come by this pub sometimes...

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Shit! What got the Guards in here?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Don't panic! We're in the Boil, what's she gonna try?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Ha! Found you!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: So, what does, ah... a fine Mounted Police Officer want with a pair of law-abiding brothers?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I'll need you to come with me to the Guards about a case of arson in the Infected neighborhood, early morning on the 24th. I have a few questions I'd like to ask.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: And if we politely decline?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Please, comply with law enforcement's work, Mr. Danton.

steps.name: Barman
steps.text: Easy there, Mount! This is the Boil you're in. Your word isn't law here.

steps.name: Barman
steps.text: Get out. You're not welcome at my bar.
In an instant, the atmosphere in the pub begins to strain. A few bruisers with vicious looks rise from their seats.
They pull out weapons, eyeing the pint-sized officer with malice.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Hahaha, this is Caladon's Boil, signora. You fancy coppers don't fit in here.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Go on back to helping the Infected scrub their chamber pots. That sounds about right for you.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: (Nine people... I've got plenty to write once the report comes...)
November 28th, 1097, 7:50 P.M.
Streets of Caladon

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Motor it! Quick, she's right behind us!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: My hand's broken!

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Suck it up and keep runnin'! This Mount's crazy!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: We can't beat that shit! Are they all like her?!

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Save it! Go for the Infected ghetto, the layout's all screwy there, we still got a chance!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Did we shake her?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Shut up, keep it down!

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: She didn't see us. We hide here, we're gold.

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Son of a bitch, something's wrong with this Mount. How the hell did she even find us?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: You save your breath.

steps.name: Little 'Witch' Minnie
steps.text: Who are... you?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Where'd the brat come from?!

steps.name: Little 'Witch' Minnie
steps.text: This is Miss Witch's house. What are you doing in here?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Shut her up! The Mount's right outside!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Stupid little punk, I oughta...

steps.name: Little 'Witch' Minnie
steps.text: I get it! You're bad people!
The immature witch extends her right hand, and a purple thunderbolt leaps from it.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: (Shoot, where'd they run?)

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Hello... can I ask if you've seen—
Just as the Kuranta officer starts talking to a nearby resident, two men dressed in black fly out from the window of a building not far away, hitting a wall with two heavy thuds.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Hot-hot-hot! Little shit!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Cavolo, stupid Infected, I'm gonna get her...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Great! So this is where you two holed up.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Shit! Cheese it!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Where the hell to?!

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: The abandoned section! There's a safehouse there!
November 28th, 1097, 8:59 P.M.
Disused border sector of Caladon
The two black-suits huff and gasp as they run through the deserted streets.
And the pint-sized Kuranta officer is hot on their tails.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: I think we lost her.

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: My ass we lost her! You think you can lose a Kuranta officer in the city? Keep running!

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: How much farther?

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Almost there! Right up front.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Made it. In here.

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Our contact was here? This safehouse is shot to hell!

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Save it. They said they'd ready up any clothes and fake IDs for skipping town, put 'em here. There's a hidden passage through the old logistics channels. We'll find a way to slip out.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Hiding in a building, huh. Not planning to give up?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Don't test my patience, alright? We're on the edge of the city. You can't fall back any further now.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: And let me remind you two, hiding in that building to ambush me isn't going to do anything for you, okay?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Keep resisting, and you'll only keep piling on the charges against you.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Put down the crossbows and bombs, and surrender this instant.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: What the hell, where is everybody? The lights are dead?!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: This room's a goddamned mess! What's all that piled on the ground? I can't even tell.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: You just knocked something over! What the hell's that smell?!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: It's too dark! I can't see anything!

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Why'd they pile up all this crap? They tryin' to pull something?

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: This stinks to high heaven! Where's our contact?!

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: I don't like this! This building ain't right!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: If you still won't come out, I'll have to break in by force.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: About time you witnessed a Mounted Officer's true strength.

The pint-sized officer reverse grips her pike and lowers her body. She lifts it over her head, Originium Arts coalescing at its tip, the pike wholly bathed in a dark red luster in the black of the night.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I haven't used this maneuver in a long, long time. Don't blame me if anyone gets hurt, alright?

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Do something! She's gonna break down the door!

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Don't panic! Calm down!

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Flashlight! You got it or not?

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: What kind of mook carries a goddamned flashlight around?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: The firebombs! You had one left, right?

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: You gonna burn the place down?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Dumbass! You throw the bomb in there first, we escape before the fire spreads! The house goes up, and that beat cop ain't gonna follow us! Two fowls, one stone!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Makes sense! Let me see...
The imposing black-suit pulls the ring on an incendiary meant for military use, and tosses it into the depths of the pitch-black room.
However—
The moment the flare lights up is the moment they finally realize just how stupid a decision they've made.
Within the cramped, dilapidated room sits a great pile of Originium explosives and hazardous chemicals.
The bucket they knocked over earlier was filled with high-concentration raw keton, now spilled all across the floor.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I'm going to count from three, and that's your final chance!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Three!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Two!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: One!
The collapsible military pike shoots forth like lightning, smashing apart at least ten centimeters' worth of concrete wall and tearing through the structure.
But in the following instant...
The sound of an explosion as grand as thunder rolls across the entirety of Caladon.
Harsh firelight follows a mushroom cloud straight into the skies, shining over the abandoned plate, through the Gododdin night, and across the southwest harbors of Victoria.
In the wake of the cabin's explosion, the surrounding ground caves in entirely, crashing down to the city plate's structural layer.
And that layer being in deep disrepair, it continues its collapse, dropping down and down, letting out an unending rumbling roar.
Where the cabin once stood now resembles a direct strike from a high-speed battleship bombardment. Only a massive pit filled with thick smoke remains to tell the tale.
The suspects, the evidence, and the truth are all blown away into the black smog along with the abandoned building, trailing high and away with the wind.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Wh... What happened?!
Blown head over heels by the shockwave, the Victorian Mounted Officer now stares in bewilderment at the entire sight before her. Nothing that just happened has processed for her yet.
November 28th, 1097.
Nighttime in Caladon City finds itself exceptionally lively.
